metadata.notes: Uses invariant_only reference because the prompt-conditioned NeMo data loader (rnnt_bpe_models_prompt) requires Lhotse cut.supervisions[0].language, which the standard transcribe(audio=[path]) API doesn't populate from target_lang. TRT path is validated via streaming transcribe of Recording.wav; the comparator gates on returncode/sanity invariants only. Future work: thread language into the cut via override_config + custom dataloader, then flip reference_backend back to hf_transformers for live WER/CER.
